text:
Ava (AE): Quick heads-up 9 CalypsoHealth POC -> procurement. They need split invoices for Calypso Inc (US), Calypso EU GmbH (DE), Calypso Labs Ltd (UK). Each entity wants its own PO and signer. DPA redline requests HSM for hosted env + 48h breach notice. Also ask for EU reverse-charge handling. Can we handle multi-entity billing + signer delegation?

procurement_calypso: Hi team  - AP team can sign OFs if you accept delegated signers. We need separate PDF invoices, VAT handling, and remit addresses. Also confirm: do you support HSM for hosted or only private?

Sean (Legal): Delegated AP signers ok with short attestation (name/title). HSM for hosted is an escalation; standard stance: HSM available for Private/Dedicated. For Hosted we can provide KMS attestation + SOC2 report. 48h notification is aggressive; propose reasonable efforts + 72h confirmation window. Also counter the 30-day deletion SLA (we need 90 days for backups).

Diego (Finance): Separate invoices per legal entity required. Need tax IDs and remit addresses before first invoice. EU reverse-charge: we require validated VAT ID. Net terms: they requested net30; finance can approve post-credit-check. If credit fails, require prepay or CC on file.

Maya (Solutions Eng): Tech side: we can tag OF with billing_entity and signer metadata. Example order form snippet: 
```
billing_entity: calypso-eu-gmbh
po_number: CH-EU-0426
vat_number: DE123456789
signer_name: "Anna Muller <ap@calypso.de>"
```
Fallback: if signer not mapped, route to parent finance alias. I'll prepare sample OF JSON + invoice schema.

Liam (Security): On HSM: Hosted customers get KMS + attestations, no dedicated HSM by default. If customer insists on HSM for hosted, it's an enterprise exception and will add cost and timeline. I'll attach KMS whitepaper and pen-test summary. Also clarify we don't support key export on Hosted.

procurement_calypso: Thanks. We'll collect VAT IDs, remit addresses, and AP signer attestation and post here today. One question: liability cap - they propose 12-months fees. Would Redwood accept a floor?

Sean (Legal): Standard counter: liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months or $250k floor, whichever is greater. We'll add a one-line attestation clause for AP signers.

Ava (AE): Great, I'll consolidate docs when I have them and loop back. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
